@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'OTel A: add swift-log and swift-metrics to the core target as API only'
+---
+## What
+
+Part A of the OpenTelemetry design that the user approved on 2026-09-28 (a copy is at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-wballard-github-swissarmyhammer/9f4fa2e8-6833-46c6-bb95-5091ae3613fa/scratchpad/otel-design.md). Libraries use only the APIs: swift-distributed-tracing, swift-log and swift-metrics. Only executables (acp-agent, acp-client, multitool-cli) depend on swift-otel and call `OTel.bootstrap`. Extras is the base package, so the other packages depend on this task.
+
+Current state: `Package.swift` has `swift-distributed-tracing` (from 1.4.1). The core target `FoundationModelsExtras` links `Tracing`. The package has no swift-log and no swift-metrics. No file in `Sources/` uses `os.Logger` or `OSSignposter` (checked with `rg` on 2026-09-28).
+
+Change `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsExtras/Package.swift`:
+- [ ] Add `.package(url: "https://github.com/apple/swift-log.git", from: <the current release>)` and `.package(url: "https://github.com/apple/swift-metrics.git", from: <the current release>)`. Add a comment in the style of the other dependencies: API only, no backend, the executables of the family bootstrap the backend.
+- [ ] Add `.product(name: "Logging", package: "swift-log")` and `.product(name: "Metrics", package: "swift-metrics")` to the `FoundationModelsExtras` target.
+- [ ] Do not add swift-otel or any backend (no `LoggingSystem.bootstrap`, no `MetricsSystem.bootstrap`) to a library target.
+- [ ] Add a small source use of each API in the core target so that the link is real, for example the logger and metric names that task D needs. If task D comes directly after, you can put this use in task D and make this task only the manifest change plus the test below.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `swift build` succeeds with the two new dependencies.
+- [ ] The core target imports `Logging` and `Metrics` with no backend.
+- [ ] No target of the package depends on swift-otel.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Add a test in `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/` (for example `Telemetry/TelemetryDependencyTests.swift`) that reads `Package.swift` through `PackageRootValidation.packageRoot()` from `Tests/TestSupport` (or `FixtureFile.packageRoot` from `FixtureSupport`) and checks that no dependency URL contains `swift-otel`.
+- [ ] `swift test --parallel` passes. When you use `swift test --filter`, use a regex with the target name and check that the count of tests that ran is not zero.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+- Do not run `swift format`. #otel
\ No newline at end of file
